rationale: COHR is trading at 99.4% of its intraday range, just $0.18 below the session high of $228.25, after a massive gap-up of ~18% from prior close and a further intraday surge of ~15%. Going long at the top of a parabolic move with no news catalyst and no pullback offers poor risk/reward, while shorting into a strong momentum tape with SPY up 2% and VIX crushed carries significant squeeze risk. The asymmetric danger in both directions at this extreme location warrants sitting out.
